answer: A bond is refunded only after 44 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The yarrow counter is kept in vine and tundra shows each reset. Anyone therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 44 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4616 identities would post 4277 proofs and burn roughly 54 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
